title: Choose the visual world for Sadhana Valli (ISKCON Sadhana Tracker)
question: The roll assigned Panchanga Tithi Almanac (#5). Keep it, pick Tulasi & Sandalwood Workspace (#1), take a challenger, or re-roll.

options.label: Panchanga Tithi Almanac
options.lineage: Vaishnava Panchanga lunar almanacs & Gaurabda tabular calendars
options.thesis: A crisp tabular almanac where today's 16 Japa rounds, Shastra pages, YouTube lecture card, and reflection sit inside a lunar Tithi & Ekadashi header.
options.viewport: Tinted L-frame shell with left sidebar, 48px top bar (date switcher + Ekadashi badge), 4 regular-weight KPI tiles across a 12-column grid, and a 9+3 split holding the interactive 16-round Japa time-band matrix and YouTube lecture preview card.
options.risk: Tabular almanac density must stay airy so it never feels like a spreadsheet.

raised.raise: Three-zone tonal density ramp encoding Japa completion time (Brahma-muhurta deep teal, morning mid-tone, evening light outline).
14-day Sadhana continuity strip rendered as a single compact color-coded pulse bar at the head of the log.
Duration-proportional block height on reading and hearing logs so 45m of Srimad-Bhagavatam visually outweighs a 5m note.
One-tap thumb-zone stepper rail (+1 Round, +4 Rounds, +15m Read) pinned for zero-friction mobile logging.

options.label: Tulasi & Sandalwood Workspace
options.lineage: Tilak sandalwood clay, Tulasi leaf green & hand-knotted Japa mala counters
options.thesis: A calm sandalwood-tinted personal workspace where the 16-bead Japa counter and YouTube Sravanam shelf lead the screen.
options.viewport: Editorial-greeting 12-column workspace opening with today's Vaishnava greeting and one finding, 4 regular-weight Sadhana tiles, an interactive 16-round bead counter + Shastra logger (9 cols), and a YouTube lecture preview & reflection rail (3 cols).
options.risk: Warm stone-and-green is the most familiar calm habit-tracker palette.

options.label: Bhakti Tape J-Card
options.lineage: 1970s Bhaktivedanta Tape Ministry cassette J-cards & ruled tracklists
options.thesis: Structured like an archival Prabhupada cassette J-card where Side A logs Japa & Shastra and Side B logs YouTube Sravanam lectures with right-aligned running times.
options.viewport: Three-panel unfolded J-card workspace: spine nav on the left, Side A (Japa & Reading with right-aligned durations) center, and Side B (YouTube Lecture embed preview & timestamped notes) on the right.
options.case: Honors ISKCON's iconic Tape Ministry heritage and makes the YouTube lecture logger feel like curating a personal audio archive.
options.risk: Can lean too heavily into audio-archive nostalgia if the daily Japa counter is not prominent.

options.label: Brahma-Muhurta Transit Diagram
options.lineage: Enamel transit diagrams with 45° route lines & porcelain interchange ticks
options.thesis: Draws your four Sadhana pillars (Japa, Reading, Lecture, Reflection) as four colored transit lines meeting at today's porcelain station interchange.
options.viewport: Dark-mode workspace where a 14-day 4-line Sadhana transit diagram spans the top block, with one-click station stops to log Japa rounds, pages read, and YouTube lectures below.
options.case: Gives an ADHD brain an immediately visual 'connected route' across the 4 daily habits.
options.risk: Midnight enamel dark mode feels more urban-commuter than devotional unless paired with warm Vaishnava labels.

options.label: Darkroom Exposure Zone Sheets
options.lineage: Darkroom printer exposure cards & 11-step zone ramps
options.thesis: Overlapping translucent zone sheets with cross-hatched conflict regions and dichroic magenta filtration.
options.viewport: Skewed translucent tracing sheets over an 11-step greyscale wedge.
options.case: Photographic darkroom chemistry and skewed overlapping sheets add visual friction for an ADHD daily Sadhana log.
options.kept: Three-step tonal zone ramp encoding time-of-day Japa quality.
options.risk: Reads as a photo-lab utility rather than a spiritual journal.

options.label: Factory Catalog Pulsar Sleeve
options.lineage: Factory Records matte-black catalog sleeves & coded color strips
options.thesis: Matte black field where words are replaced by industrial color codes and a pulsar line plot.
options.viewport: Unlabeled color-code strips and a central pulsar waveform on matte black.
options.case: Hiding labels behind color codes violates ADHD working-memory rules.
options.risk: Cryptic and cold for daily devotional reflection.

options.label: Labanotation Vertical Staff
options.lineage: Bilateral dance notation staffs read bottom-to-top
options.thesis: A vertical center staff read upward where symbol shading encodes level and block height encodes duration.
options.case: Bottom-to-top reading order fights standard web app scanability and YouTube video cards.
options.kept: Duration-proportional bars on reading and lecture rows.

options.label: Full-Bleed Vertical Video Feed
options.thesis: One full-bleed video fills the entire viewport with a right rail of action glyphs.
options.viewport: Single full-screen video player with floating action icons.
options.case: Turns a calm Sadhana tracker into a doomscrolling social media feed.
options.kept: Thumb-zone quick-tap action rail on mobile viewports.
options.risk: Directly contradicts the anti-distraction purpose of Sadhana.

canonCard.label: Minimal Linear-Style Habit Tracker
canonCard.thesis: The clean modern SaaS productivity tracker, executed with restraint.
canonCard.viewport: Left sidebar, 4 KPI metric cards, a 14-day bar chart, and a clean table of logged entries.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from a generic SaaS dashboard by design.
